description: Query real Search Console performance data: clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position, grouped by the dimensions you choose. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (GSC data lags ~2-3 days). Use dimensions like ['query'], ['page'], ['query','page'], or ['date'] for trends.

searchType.description: Traffic source — 'discover' shows Google Discover performance
